mapper.select:
SELECT a.ANSWER_ID as answerId, a.QUESTION_ID as questionId, a.LAWYER_ID as lawyerId, a.CONTENT as content, a.IS_ADOPTED as isAdopted, a.CREATED_AT as createdAt, a.UPDATED_AT as updatedAt, m.NAME as lawyerName, -- 변호사 이름 l.OFFICE_NAME as officeName, -- 사무소 명 l.SPECIALty as specialty, -- 전문 분야
l.ADOPT_CNT as adoptCnt, /* 💡 물리 컬럼 (존재함) */
/* 💡 수정: 존재하지 않는 l.ANSWER_CNT 대신 서브쿼리 사용 */ (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TB_ANSWER WHERE LAWYER_ID = l.LAWYER_ID) as answerCnt,
att.SAVE_PATH as lawyerProfile -- 변호사 프로필 사진 FROM TB_ANSWER a JOIN TB_LAWYER l ON a.LAWYER_ID = l.LAWYER_ID JOIN TB_MEMBER m ON l.MEMBER_ID = m.MEMBER_ID LEFT OUTER JOIN TB_ATTACHMENT att ON l.LAWYER_ID = att.REF_ID AND att.REF_TYPE = 'LAWYER' WHERE a.QUESTION_ID = #{questionId} ORDER BY a.IS_ADOPTED DESC, a.CREATED_AT ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TB_ANSWER ( ANSWER_ID, QUESTION_ID, LAWYER_ID, CONTENT, IS_ADOPTED, CREATED_AT ) VALUES ( SEQ_ANSWER.NEXTVAL, #{questionId}, #{lawyerId}, #{content}, 'N', SYSDATE )
mapper.update: UPDATE TB_ANSWER SET IS_ADOPTED = 'Y', UPDATED_AT = SYSDATE WHERE ANSWER_ID = #{answerId}
UPDATE TB_ANSWER SET content = #{content}, updated_at = SYSDATE WHERE answer_id = #{answerId}
